searchText: Hello! I was surprised to see today that my validator has a pending withdrawal for the outstanding ETH. I didn't know that they would be automatic as soon as the 0x01 withdrawal credentials would be set, I thought it would be on demand only. Does it mean that it will constantly withdraw the outstanding balance to the eth1 address, every few days? yes and its totally free (no gas costs/fee) Let’s see how many BLS addresses aren’t able to change to 0x01.
